trust_decision.summary: HttpHeader::parse decides message framing from Transfer-Encoding: 'identity' silently deletes TE (after Content-Length was already deleted), leaving a message with no framing instead of flagging teUnsupported_ for rejection by request/response framing checks.

landing_point.why: The only Transfer-Encoding value interpretation in the tree; grep for Transfer-Encoding/identity leads straight here.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP request from client (client_side.cc:1628 checkEntityFraming) and HTTP response from origin/peer (http.cc:1353); both parse headers through HttpHeader::parse
fix_sites.module_kind: core HTTP header parser (shared by request and response paths)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No dismissable route found: both request (src/HttpRequest.cc:654) and response (src/http.cc:1353) framing checks already consume unsupportedTe(), so removing the identity branch at the single parse site closes both.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Transfer-Encoding: chunked must still be accepted (header kept for chunked()), and TE in prohibited contexts (1xx/204, trailers) must still be silently deleted rather than rejected.

O6_input_shapes: Transfer-Encoding: identity (case-insensitive via caseCmp), with or without Content-Length

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate parse of ICAP-adapted HTTP headers that re-implements TE value interpretation with its own 'identity' tolerance
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ICAP code already has its own parsers (TrailerParser, ChunkExtensionValueParser) and a maintainer could plausibly special-case legacy encodings for adapted messages.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: response-side check that treats a deprecated TE value as no-coding before unsupportedTe() is consulted
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Origin compatibility workarounds for legacy servers are common in the response path.

O9_family: HTTP request smuggling / message-framing parser differential (CWE-444)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (bootstrap.sh/configure/make), g++ or clang, cppunit for unit tests
O10_build.project_tests: src/tests/testHttpRequest.cc, src/tests/testHttpReply.cc, src/tests/testHttp1Parser.cc (no tests added by the fix diff); behaviour testable offline via a local squid with loopback client/origin

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete the identity branch so it falls into teUnsupported_ — which is exactly the published fix, so the tempting fix is the right one.

out_of_scope_notes: ICAP/eCAP-adapted messages are not re-checked with unsupportedTe(); framing there is ICAP-encapsulated, so not pursued.
unverified: Whether any HTTP/1.0 or relaxed_header_parser path treats the remaining body differently was not traced end to end.
present_in_latest not applicable (no O8 routes; latest release: none).
